programme.title: Man Who Cried for Revenge

programme.title: Return of Shanghai Joe

programme.title: The Reward's Yours... The Man's Mine

programme.title: Bastard, Go and Kill

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican

programme.title: Companeros!

programme.title: Django... Adios!

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!

programme.title: Savage Pampas
